name: Refactoring Workflow
description: Multi-agent workflow for large-scale, safe code refactoring

agents.name: Analysis Agent
agents.role: Identify refactoring opportunities and create a prioritized plan
tasks: Scan codebase for code smells (long functions, duplication, high complexity)
Identify modules with highest technical debt
Prioritize refactoring targets by risk and impact

agents.name: Test Baseline Agent
agents.role: Ensure sufficient test coverage before refactoring begins
tasks: Review coverage report from analysis agent
Write missing tests for modules to be refactored
Commit test baseline — this is the safety net

agents.name: Refactor Agent A
agents.role: Refactor module A (assigned from analysis plan)
tasks: Apply refactoring incrementally (one change at a time)

agents.name: Refactor Agent B
agents.role: Refactor module B (assigned from analysis plan)
tasks: Apply refactoring incrementally (one change at a time)

agents.name: Verification Agent
agents.role: Verify all refactoring is complete and nothing is broken
tasks: Create summary PR with before/after metrics
